questions.solution: The number of triangles in the given figure are shown below: 1) Number of triangles = [Number of parts × (1 + Number of parts)] ÷ 2 = [2 × (1 + 2)] ÷ 2 = [2 × 3] ÷ 2 = 6 ÷ 2
